desc: Read input – parse N, K, and the three sequences A, B, C.
Sort sequences – sort A, B, C in descending order.
Initialize heap and visited set – push the triple (0,0,0) with its value, mark visited.
Encode visited triples as a single integer i*N*N + j*N + k to use a fast set of ints.
Process K pops – for each pop, if it's the K-th pop output the value; otherwise push the three valid, unvisited neighbors with their computed values.
